blueprint_concepts: PS = e PM form for a conic
Definition of a conic; focus-directrix property PS = e.PM

concept_use.PS = e PM form for a conic: PS = e PM form at the point (3,4) gives e = 1/2, so the conic is an ellipse.
concept_use.Definition of a conic; focus-directrix p: Definition of a conic by focus and directrix: the focus-directrix distance a/e - ae = 15 and the centre on the axis at ae = 5 from the focus, away from the directrix.

english: A conic $\Sigma$ has a focus at the origin $O$, the corresponding directrix is the line $3x+4y=75$, and $\Sigma$ passes through the point $(3,4)$. If $(\alpha,\beta)$ is the centre of $\Sigma$, then the value of $\alpha+\beta$ is ______.
hindi: एक शांकव $\Sigma$ की एक नाभि मूलबिन्दु $O$ पर है, संगत नियता रेखा $3x+4y=75$ है, तथा $\Sigma$ बिन्दु $(3,4)$ से होकर जाता है। यदि $(\alpha,\beta)$, $\Sigma$ का केन्द्र है, तो $\alpha+\beta$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Distance from focus to directrix $=\dfrac{75}{5}=15=\dfrac{a}{e}-ae=2a-\dfrac{a}{2}\Rightarrow a=10$, $ae=5$
The centre is on the perpendicular from $O$ to the directrix, at distance $ae=5$ from $O$, on the side away from the directrix: $-5\cdot\dfrac{(3,4)}{5}=(-3,-4)$
solution_full: By the focus-directrix definition, every point $P$ of $\Sigma$ satisfies $PS=e\cdot PM$, where $PM$ is the distance from $P$ to the directrix.
At $P=(3,4)$: $PS=5$ and $PM=\dfrac{|9+16-75|}{5}=10$, so $e=\dfrac{1}{2}<1$: $\Sigma$ is an ellipse.

For an ellipse, the focus and the corresponding directrix are at distances $ae$ and $\dfrac{a}{e}$ from the centre, on the same side, along the major axis. So the distance from focus to directrix is $\dfrac{a}{e}-ae=2a-\dfrac{a}{2}=\dfrac{3a}{2}$.

The major axis is the perpendicular from $O$ to the directrix, direction $\dfrac{1}{5}(3,4)$. The centre is at distance $5$ from $O$ on the side away from the directrix: $(\alpha,\beta)=-5\cdot\dfrac{1}{5}(3,4)=(-3,-4)$.

Check by expansion: $100(x^{2}+y^{2})=(3x+4y-75)^{2}$ gives $91x^{2}-24xy+84y^{2}+450x+600y-5625=0$; the partial derivatives $182x-24y+450$ and $-24x+168y+600$ vanish at $(-3,-4)$. (Also $(3,4)$ is the vertex nearer the directrix: $a-ae=5$.)
originality_note: New: the eccentricity is not given and is read from one point by PS = e PM, after which the centre follows from a/e - ae and the direction away from the directrix (way 5, two stages through one definition). Closest known: equation of the ellipse with given focus, directrix and eccentricity. Different because: e must first be found, and the centre is asked, which needs the geometry of focus, directrix and centre rather than only expansion.
